content.text: This file is already a well-built, polished component (progressive enhancement, reduced-motion handling, persisted prefs, cross-tab sync). One real bug I found: `restartAnimations()` forces a reflow via `circleBtn.offsetWidth`, but the animated elements are the SVG circles inside it — forcing reflow on the button doesn't reliably reflow its descendants in all browsers, so speed changes can fail to restart the animation cleanly. I'll fix that by reflowing each animated element directly.
